'''Information Procedures''' was a branch of [[Situational Enforcement/Legends|Situational Enforcement]], part of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. Working closely with [[Operational Multisystem Management]], their [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] strove to ensure the security of the Authority's transmissions. They also handled individual [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. Information Procedures had four branches; [[Data Theft]], [[Extortion]], [[Industrial Espionage (Information Procedures)|Industrial Espionage]], and [[Patent Infringement]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
